## Huineng on awakening

Huineng (638–713) approaches awakening within Chan Buddhism. Buddha-nature is originally present; enlightenment is sudden recognition rather than gradual accumulation of merit alone. “No-thought,” non-attachment, and seeing nature (jianxing) structure practice. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets awakening most directly—useful for searches such as “huineng quotes on awakening.”
